SELECT f.sales_line_id, f.receipt_id, f.line_no, f.sale_date, f.sale_ts_utc, s.store_id, f.channel_code, f.channel_id, f.quantity, f.net_amount, f.staff_purchase_flag, f.etl_loaded_at
FROM fact_sales_line f JOIN dim_store s ON s.store_key=f.store_key JOIN dim_product p ON p.product_key=f.product_key

SELECT business_date, receipts, units_sold, net_sales_before_returns, returns_net, net_sales FROM rpt_daily_store_sales WHERE store_id=131 AND business_date BETWEEN DATE '2026-09-28' AND DATE '2026-10-04' ORDER BY 1

SELECT f.sale_date, COUNT(DISTINCT f.receipt_id) receipts, SUM(f.quantity) units, SUM(f.net_amount) net_before, COUNT(*) n_lines, COUNT(DISTINCT (f.receipt_id, f.line_no)) n_distinct_lines,
 SUM(CASE WHEN CAST(timezone('Europe/Helsinki', f.sale_ts_utc AT TIME ZONE 'UTC') AS DATE) <> f.sale_date THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) date_mismatch
FROM fact_sales_line f JOIN dim_store s ON s.store_key=f.store_key JOIN dim_product p ON p.product_key=f.product_key
WHERE s.store_id=131 AND p.category<>'ZZ Test' AND f.sale_date BETWEEN DATE '2026-09-28' AND DATE '2026-10-04'
GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1
